Ginkgo Biloba

Remedy cognitive circulation antioxidant

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Herb known for improving circulation, especially to the brain, and enhancing cognitive function and memory.

Indications

  • memory issues
  • poor circulation
  • vertigo
  • tinnitus

Contraindications

  • bleeding disorders
  • upcoming surgery
  • blood thinners

Preparations

  • standardized extract
  • tea
  • capsule

Body Systems Affected

  • nervous
  • cardiovascular

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Metabolic Syndrome
    Cluster of conditions including high blood pressure, high blood sugar, excess body fat around the waist, and abnormal cholesterol levels.
  • Menopause
    Natural biological process marking the end of menstrual cycles and fertility in women.
  • Prostatitis
    Inflammation of the prostate gland, often causing pain and urinary symptoms.
